title: v2 dashboard save must strip metadata.resourceVersion on both create and update paths (keep in sync with v1)
answers: Saving a new v2 dashboard fails when k8s metadata has a resourceVersion
Why does importing or creating a dashboard with schema v2 fail on save?
Where is resourceVersion removed before dashboard save?
Does dashboard create POST send resourceVersion?
body:
Symptom: Saving a new dashboard through the v2 (schema v2 / k8s) API fails when the incoming k8s metadata carries a resourceVersion (e.g. `k8s: { resourceVersion: '0' }` from an import or copied dashboard).
Root cause: public/app/features/dashboard/api/v2.ts:K8sDashboardV2API.saveDashboard deleted `obj.metadata.resourceVersion` only inside the `if (obj.metadata.name)` update branch, so the create path (`client.create`, a POST) sent a resourceVersion, which a create request must not carry.
Fix pattern: Delete `obj.metadata.resourceVersion` unconditionally, before branching between update (name set -> client.update / PUT) and create (no name -> POST). This matches the logic already in public/app/features/dashboard/api/v1.ts. Removing the `DeprecatedInternalId` label still happens only on the update path.
Constraints: Any change to save-path metadata handling in v1.ts or v2.ts should be mirrored in the other. Tests in public/app/features/dashboard/api/v2.test.ts check this with `mockPost.mock.calls[0][1].metadata` not having resourceVersion, and check that mockPut is not called.
applies: Frontend dashboard save via K8sDashboardV2API (and v1 counterpart) in public/app/features/dashboard/api
